originalTitle: Watch: Hong Kong crowds queue to see Van Gogh painting unveiled for first time in 60 years
summary: Châtaigniers en fleurs, also known as Chestnut Trees in Blossom, is expected to receive record bids at auction this weekend.
content:
One of Vincent van Gogh's paintings not seen publicly for more than 60 years has drawn crowds in Hong Kong, where it has been displayed ahead of auction this weekend in New York.

Van Gogh painted Châtaigniers en fleurs (Chestnut Trees in Blossom) in the French village of Auvers-sur-Oise, about two months before he died in 1890.

Sotheby's estimates the painting will fetch $180m (£136m), which would mark the highest auction price for a Van Gogh artwork.
chineseTitle: 观看：香港民众排队观看梵高画作 60 年来首次亮相
chineseSummary: Châtaigniers en fleurs（也称为“开花的栗树”）预计在本周末的拍卖会上获得创纪录的出价。
chineseContent:
文森特·梵高 (Vincent van Gogh) 的一幅 60 多年来未公开露面的画作在香港吸引了众多观众，并于本周末在纽约拍卖之前在香港展出。

梵高于 1890 年去世前大约两个月，在法国瓦兹河畔奥维尔村创作了《Châtaigniers en fleurs》（开花的栗树）。

苏富比估计这幅画将拍出 1.8 亿美元（1.36 亿英镑）的价格，这将创下梵高艺术品的最高拍卖价格。
